sentences.en: Layla was babysitting in the neighborhood where she lived.
sentences.zh: Layla 在她居住的社区里当临时保姆。

sentences.en: Layla has experience with babysitting multiple kids at the same time.
sentences.zh: Layla 曾经同时照看过多个孩子，有这方面的经验。

sentences.en: Layla was babysitting kids from time to time.
sentences.zh: Layla 偶尔会帮人带小孩。
